passage.quote:
The execution environment describes which threads are grouped together, which
memory each can access, and which participants a synchronization operation can
coordinate. It also states the GPU and PTX-version requirements of instructions.

summary: Describe where threads belong, which storage they may access and which instruction forms their GPU and PTX version support.
Keep access permission and hardware support separate from the rules governing which writes a read may observe.
Connect scalar execution to a specific allocation contract without silently assuming every environment check is included in every execution model.
remaining: Thread grouping, supplied-allocation access checks, a restricted load/store eligibility checker and the scalar allocation connection are implemented. CPU thread execution, allocation creation and lifetime, resolution of physical pointers and full instruction/hardware validation remain outside the implemented environment.
